import unittest

from solution import group_tree


class GroupTreeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(group_tree([]), [])

    def test_preorder_all_branches_and_input_order(self):
        records = [
            {"id": "r1", "parent": None, "label": "Root 1"},
            {"id": "a", "parent": "r1", "label": "A"},
            {"id": "r2", "parent": None, "label": "Root 2"},
            {"id": "b", "parent": "r1", "label": "B"},
            {"id": "a1", "parent": "a", "label": "A1"},
            {"id": "b1", "parent": "b", "label": "B1"},
            {"id": "r2c", "parent": "r2", "label": "R2 child"},
        ]
        original = [row.copy() for row in records]
        self.assertEqual(group_tree(records), [
            {"depth": 0, "labels": ["Root 1", "Root 2"]},
            {"depth": 1, "labels": ["A", "B"]},
            {"depth": 2, "labels": ["A1"]},
            {"depth": 2, "labels": ["B1"]},
            {"depth": 1, "labels": ["R2 child"]},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(records, original)

    def test_forward_parent_reference_is_valid(self):
        records = [
            {"id": "child", "parent": "root", "label": "Child"},
            {"id": "root", "parent": None, "label": "Root"},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(group_tree(iter(records)), [
            {"depth": 0, "labels": ["Root"]},
            {"depth": 1, "labels": ["Child"]},
        ])

    def test_returned_label_lists_are_new_and_independent(self):
        records = [
            {"id": "r", "parent": None, "label": "R"},
            {"id": "c", "parent": "r", "label": "C"},
        ]
        result = group_tree(records)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["labels"], result[1]["labels"])
        result[0]["labels"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["label"], "R")
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["labels"], ["C"])

    def test_malformed_records_raise_value_error(self):
        cases = [
            None,
            [1],
            [{"id": "x", "parent": None}],
            [{"id": "x", "parent": None, "label": "X", "extra": 1}],
            [{"id": "", "parent": None, "label": "X"}],
            [{"id": 1, "parent": None, "label": "X"}],
            [{"id": "x", "parent": "", "label": "X"}],
            [{"id": "x", "parent": 1, "label": "X"}],
            [{"id": "x", "parent": None, "label": 1}],
            [{"id": "x", "parent": None, "label": "X"},
             {"id": "x", "parent": None, "label": "Again"}],
            [{"id": "x", "parent": "missing", "label": "X"}],
        ]
        for records in cases:
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    group_tree(records)

    def test_self_and_multi_node_cycles_raise_value_error(self):
        cases = [
            [{"id": "x", "parent": "x", "label": "X"}],
            [{"id": "a", "parent": "b", "label": "A"},
             {"id": "b", "parent": "a", "label": "B"}],
        ]
        for records in cases:
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    group_tree(records)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
